TITLE: Iran Update Special Report, May 20, 2026
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-20 22:38 UTC
AUTHOR: Nadia Sleiman (ISW/CTP)

KEY TAKEAWAYS:

1. **HORMUZ PROTECTION RACKET** (Reuters investigation via Iranian officials, May 20):
   - Iran using ceasefire to "normalize control" over Strait of Hormuz
   - Multi-tiered transit fee system run by IRGC:
     - Top tier: strategic partners Russia + China prioritized
     - Mid tier: India + Pakistan via negotiated transit agreements
     - Other countries case-by-case
     - Vessels with links to Iranian adversaries: denied access entirely
     - Ships without bilateral agreement: ~$150,000 fee
   - Framed as "security" fees — ISW: "mafia-esque protection racket in which vessels pay Iran so the Iranian navy can 'secure' the vessels against an attack by the Iranian navy or Iranian shore-based missiles and drones"
   - 16 vessels took Iran's route through strait May 19-20 (2 Chinese + HK VLCCs, 1 S Korean VLCC, 1 Turkish-owned exiting; 1 Indian-flagged entering)
   - Iraqi gov't agreement to facilitate Greek-owned Maltese-flagged VLCC Agios Fanourios I carrying Iraqi crude on May 10

2. **EUROPEAN POST-WAR DEPLOYMENT** would likely face Iranian forceful resistance if war ends with de facto recognition of Iranian sovereignty over strait

3. **NORMALIZATION RISK**: gradually increasing vessel flows could weaken arguments for mobilizing US allies to reopen strait

4. **US TANKER SEIZURES**:
   - M/T SKYWAVE (IMO 9328716) seized by US forces between May 19-20 — sanctioned March 13 for transporting Iranian oil
   - M/T CELESTIAL SEA (IMO 9397030) — US Marines boarded May 20 on suspicion of attempting to reach Iranian port; released after search + course change
   - CENTCOM: 91 vessels redirected, 4 disabled since April 13 blockade began

5. **IRGC THREAT**: May 20 threatened to expand war "far beyond the region" if US-Israeli strikes resume
   - Capabilities listed: terror attacks abroad, expanding shipping attacks (Bab el-Mandeb via Houthis), longer-range missile strikes (demonstrated nascent at Diego Garcia ~4000km)
   - Recent European disruptions of Iranian-backed plots in France, Norway, Belgium
   - Iranian-backed Kataib Hezbollah commander Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawoud al Saadi charged with planning attacks in US, Canada, Europe

6. **PAKISTAN-SAUDI DEFENSE PACT**:
   - Reuters May 18: Pakistan sent 8,000 troops + squadron of fighter jets + air defence system to Saudi Arabia
   - Part of September 2025 mutual defence pact
   - Reuters described as "substantial" and "combat-ready"
   - Aircraft sent in April; other assets timing unspecified
   - Pakistan simultaneously mediating US-Iran talks (Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi travelled to Tehran May 20)

7. **QATAR MEDIATION**: also playing role; Qatari delegation sent to Iran for tangible commitments + US frozen assets specifics (Axios May 20)

IRAN NUCLEAR (WSJ May 20):
- Iran STILL UNABLE to enrich uranium — would have to dig fissile material from underneath rubble
- US/Israeli strikes during 12-Day War (June 2025) damaged Natanz, Fordow, Esfahan
- Buried Iran's HEU stockpile + likely destroyed all/significant centrifuges

INTERNAL DYNAMICS:
- AP May 20: IRGC teaching Iranian civilians how to use arms; military vehicles + ballistic missile displayed at wedding
- French media: Iranian authorities set up military training booths
- NYT May 20: Israel developed plan to free former Iranian President Ahmadinejad from house arrest to lead regime change — derailed when Israeli airstrikes injured him on Feb 28 (killed 3 of his security detail)

HEZBOLLAH:
- First PROLONGED engagement since ceasefire began: Haddatha (Bint Jbeil District) May 19-20
- Hezbollah defended against 2 separate IDF attacks (7h + 4h)
- Used small arms, mortars, RPGs, ATGMs, FPV drones
- Hezbollah claimed to repel first IDF advance; did NOT claim second (IDF likely dislodged Hezbollah, destroyed homes after engagement)
